title: Gas leak after the quake
scenario: Smell of gas, rotten-egg odor, or hissing sound from pipes or appliances after an earthquake.
steps: Get out of the building immediately, taking everyone with you.
Do not use switches or flames — no light switches, no lighters, no matches, no candles, nothing electrical on or off.
Leave the door open as you exit and move well away from the building.
From a safe distance, call 911 and the gas company.
Only turn off the gas at the outside meter if you know how and can do it without going back inside danger.
Do not re-enter until officials say it is safe.
do_not: Never search for the source of a gas smell.
Do not start a car in an attached garage if you smell gas.
